reviews.title: Chunky Boy
reviews.comment: Best value mid range card you can get. Its a big chunk of a gpu so it's not going to fit every case. It runs cool and i hit max clocks easily and my sustained clocks are well above 3300 Mhz.
reviews.author: JoshuaE

reviews.title: Just get it!
reviews.comment: I first went to the amd website and downloaded & installed  the full softare package but started having issues in quake 2 rtx after a few days. Then i Uninstalled the package software and downloaded just the drivers on Driver Easy. It blows the amd software package away. Getting greater graphics and framerates. Come on amd lets get it together.
reviews.author: soyo400

reviews.title: Amazing Value
reviews.comment: [Employee of bestbuy] Amazing 1080p to 1440p card! I’ve been using it in 4K for my “Home Theater” PC and still runs most games around 50-70 in 4K!
